_comment: Career reading (PRD F6): work style by dominant element and career paths per element. Paths are ideas to explore, never instructions or promises.

workStyle.fire: Your chart leans toward fire, so you may work best with energy, freedom and a goal to chase.
workStyle.earth: Your chart leans toward earth, so you may work best with clear steps, steady routines and practical results.
workStyle.air: Your chart leans toward air, so you may work best with ideas, conversation and variety.
workStyle.water: Your chart leans toward water, so you may work best where feelings, care and meaning matter.

fire.title: Entrepreneurship and leadership
fire.why: Your fiery energy may suit roles where you take charge, start projects or run your own business.

fire.title: Sales, marketing and promotion
fire.why: You may be good at inspiring people and getting them excited about an idea.

fire.title: Sports, fitness and coaching
fire.why: Active, hands-on work can suit your drive and love of a challenge.

fire.title: Performing and creative arts
fire.why: Roles with an audience can let your confidence and warmth shine.

earth.title: Building, engineering and trades
earth.why: You may enjoy practical work where you can see and touch what you made.

earth.title: Business, accounting and administration
earth.why: Your patience and eye for order can suit roles that keep things running smoothly.

earth.title: Food, farming and nature
earth.why: Work close to the land, plants or food can feel grounding and real to you.

earth.title: Crafts, design and quality work
earth.why: You may have a gift for making things beautiful, useful and built to last.

air.title: Communication, media and writing
air.why: Your way with words and ideas may suit work that informs or connects people.

air.title: Teaching and training
air.why: You may enjoy explaining things and helping others learn.

air.title: Technology and research
air.why: Curious, logical work with new ideas and systems can keep you engaged.

air.title: Law, negotiation and client work
air.why: Your sense of fairness and gift for conversation can help in roles that bring people to agreement.

water.title: Caring and helping professions
water.why: You may feel fulfilled in work that looks after people, such as nursing, care or counseling.

water.title: Social work and community service
water.why: Your empathy can make a real difference in roles that support families and communities.

water.title: Arts, music and heartfelt creative work
water.why: Creative work that expresses feelings can be deeply satisfying for you.

water.title: Hospitality and welcoming spaces
water.why: Making people feel welcome and comfortable, in hotels, restaurants or homes, may come naturally to you.

rulers._comment: House rulers (traditional). Shown when review is approved. Frames take {destination}.
rulers.intro: Each house is ruled by a planet, set by the sign at the start of that house. Where the ruling planet sits shows where that part of life tends to find its energy.

frames.10: Your public role and reputation tend to grow through {destination}.
frames.6: Your everyday work tends to flow best through {destination}.
frames.2: What you value at work, and what helps you feel secure, tends to connect with {destination}.

destinations.1: your own initiative and the way you present yourself
destinations.2: practical skills, steady effort and things you truly value
destinations.3: communication, writing, teaching or local connections
destinations.4: home, family or work that builds a sense of belonging
destinations.5: creativity, self-expression and work that feels like play
destinations.6: service, useful routines and skills you build day by day
destinations.8: shared projects, research and work that goes deep
destinations.9: learning, travel, teaching or big-picture ideas
destinations.11: teams, networks and causes you believe in
destinations.12: quiet, behind-the-scenes work, care or reflection
